page.layout: One printed title page, one block of text; a woodcut engraving in the centre with vertical labels beside it; no margin notes. Reading order: title lines top to bottom, then the woodcut with its side labels, then the imprint lines below.

main_text.l: Quibus perspicuè ex verbo Dei cùm hujus Epistolae, tum etiam totius Scripturae demonstratur autoritas, & alij explicantur loci utiles scitu & hoc nostro seculo maximè necessarii.

page.notes: The woodcut shows three winged figures in clouds with a wheel at the right; side labels read CONSILIO (left, running upward) and NVMINIS (right, running downward). The label text is printed around the engraving and is not part of the main text. A handwritten "5." and a "+" appear at the top right corner; these are manuscript marks and are left out. The date is printed in the old form CIↃ. IↃ. LXXXIV, rendered as MDLXXXIV.
